Breathe: Allows the imbiber to breathe underwater or in any environment including a vacuum. It allows the user to turn the molecules around them into useful oxygen which is magically transported to the lungs. In a total vacuum it uses extra body cells, mostly water. The potion lasts 2d6 hours, half that time in vacuum.

Delusion: Imbiber believes they are affected as if under the influence of another potion for the duration. An Illusion Resistance is required to break the effect.

Enlarging: Increases the imbiber`s size to a random height and weight with accompying Strength bonus.
Flying: Allows the user to fly as the spell Fly. The user may carry their weight limit or less aloft with them.
Healing: Heals 3d6+3 to all areas of the body. It is magical and works against all types of damage including acid-based. lf this potion is ingested before the character takes damage, it will heal damage as it is taken, once for each area (this effect lasts only 3d6 minutes).
Life Giving: Grants intelligence as the spell Endow Intelligence and gives or intensifies lifeforce to whatever object or animal on which it is applied. The effects are permanent. lt has no effect on an already sapient object or creature.
Life Saving: Resurrects a being if they make a Will Force save. lf a being is resurrected by this potion, then he or she must rest for 1 hour per day that she was dead. It doesn`t resurrect characters that have been dead for more days than they had Will Force in life.
Mental Power: Gives the user the following abilities: Improved Telepathy as the spell, Scrying as the spell, and Time Sight as the spell for the duration. All effects are at 20 Aura.
Mystical Mage: Grants the following for the duration: +1d4 Intelligence, and Knowledge, +4 Aura, +4 Aura Control, and 75% Thought Projection.
Pious Priest: Grants the following for the duration: +1d4 Wisdom, Knowledge, and Piety, +20% to Commune, doubles Healing and Bless effects, and Protection from Good or Evil (100%) for duration.
Polymorphing: Changes the imbiber into a predetermined creature for the duration as the spell Change Other (at 20 Aura).
Protection(Animals): Makes the opponent type (Animals) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made. Animals referes to any altered or magical animals over 4 Intelligence. Those non-sapients under 5 are not afforded a resistance.
Protection(Align:Evil): Makes the opponent type (Evil aligned beings) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Protection(Align:Good): Makes the opponent type (Good aligned beings) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Protection(Align:Neutral): Makes the opponent type (Neutral aligned beings) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Protection(Angels/Archons): Makes the opponent type (Angels/Archons) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Protection(Demons/Devils): Makes the opponent type (Demons/Devils) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Protection(Dragons): Makes the opponent type (Dragons) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Protection(Enemies): Makes the opponent type (All Enemies) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Protection(Giants): Makes the opponent type (Giants) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Protection(Humanoids): Makes the opponent type (Humanoids) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Protection(Supernatural): Makes the opponent type (Supernatural) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Protection(Undead): Makes the opponent type (Undead) unable to attack unless a Control Resistance is made.
Reducing: Reduces the imbiber to a predetermined height for the duration.
Speed: Increases the imbiber`s speed which has the following effects: imbiber always wins initiative, 2d4+2 extra seconds of action per round, -2 to be hit by physical attacks, -4 to be hit by missile attacks.
Super Healing: Heals 3d8+6 to all areas of the body. It is magical and works against all types of damage including acid-based. lf this potion is ingested before the character takes damage, it will heal damage as it is taken, once for each area (this effect lasts only 3d6 minutes).
Telekinesis: Allows the imbiber to pick up objects with their mind. The total weight of all objects lifted cannot exceed 10 lb. per Intelligence point. The character can move the objects at a rate of 60` per 10 seconds.
Telepathy: Grants the ability to read minds for the duration, but not the ability to mentally attack.
Tricky Thief: Grants the following abilities: 2-5 Agility, invisibility 3 times during the potion`s effect, +1d4 seconds of action for the entire duration, immune to poison, detect treasure in a 30` radius, and Non-detection.
Wondrous Warrior: Grants the following: +1d4 Strength, Agility, Vitality, +3d6 Endurance points, and Berserking 50%.
Animal Avoidance: Masks user`s scent, muffles user`s sounds and makes the affected being invisible. These effects only relate to animals and magical animal perceptions. Magical Animals can make a Control Resistance to avoid the effects of this potion.
Regeneration: Grants Greater Regeneration, 1d4 points are healed per 10 seconds to all wounded areas (including vitals). Cannot regenerate from fire or acid damage or if head and heart are separated.
Conceal Life Force: Conceals life force, making the imbiber undetectable to Life Sense and the like.
Crypt Invasion: The mixture can be used on any non-magical stone or wood to burrow through it. Spread the mixture into the shape of a doorway, hole, or any other opening (large enough for a 6` humanoid) and let sit until it dissolves away the material.
Death Stench: Disguise the imbiber as a corpse due to smell and slow respiration.
Holy Fog: When the potion is smashed or broken, the chemical and magical reaction produces a thick fog with all the properties of holy water. The fog spreads across the ground at a height of 20` and covers an area 40` in diameter. Any creatures caught inside the fog will lose all visibility unless a Magic Resistance is made. Any undead caught inside the fog will be inflicted with 3d4 damage every second they remain within. Unless the fog is blown away, it dissipates after 1 minute.
Life Sensing: Spread the paste over the wrappings and set out until the cloth is saturated. Tie the cloth around your eyes like a blindfold. The result will be the ability to life sense up to 60` away for the duration, as long as the blindfold is worn.
Nightmare: The imbiber is plagued with nightmares (resulting in fatigue and even insanity) at their next sleep. Will Force save to avoid both fatigue and possible insanity.
Phase: By consuming half the potion, the drinker is allowed to phase. Consuming the second half will allow the drinker to unphase.
Turn a Deaf Ear: Allows the user to hear normal conversations but blocks sounds above a scream. If used to stop the wail or howl of a banshee, the wax `potion` has a Magic Resistance of 30%.
Vampire Repulsion: Gives the imbiber protection from vampires in the form of Coexist with Undead (as the spell at 20 Aura) but only towards vampires.
Breath of the Sea: Grants breathe as the potion (or the spell Breathless), Invulnerability, and Endure Cold.
Flight of the Zephyr: Grants Magical flight, Breathe as the potion (or the spell Breathless), Invulnerability, and Endure Cold. Within 30 minutes of the potion beginning to fail, magical flight becomes Levitation (allowing only for ascent or decent).
Salamander`s Touch: Grants breathe as the potion (or the spell Breathless), Invulnerability, and Endure Heat.
Masking Body: Appear in an alternate illusionary form per the spells Illusion of Sight, Smell, Sound, Taste, Touch.
Masking Mind: Appear to have an alternate mind per the spell Illusion of Feeling when mentally contacted, also acts as the spell Mind Set unless an Illusion Resistance is requested and made.
Non-Detection: Acts as the spell Non-Detection for the duration.
Plane Shifting: Projects the spirit of the drinker onto an open plane of their choice. The drinker`s body remains in repose, breathing but otherwise unmoving for the duration.
Shadow Walking: Physically shifts the drinker unto the Plane of Shadow. The user remains there until the duration expires then is returned to their plane of origin. This potion will not work unless the Shadow Plane is accessible from the current plane.
Sleeping Potion(Strong): Causes the imbiber to make a Magic Resistance or fall into a deep, unwaking dreamless sleep. The victim cannot be woken save by magical or divine effects. The victim is also sustained as the Sustenance invocation needing neither food nor water and Breathless as the spell, appearing to be in a near suspended state, though the victim still ages.
Invisibility: The imbiber becomes invisible and all light of any visible wave length passes through them until they take hostile action or the duration expires. Whenever hostile action is taken there is a 10% cumulative chance of appearing. The 1st hostile action is 10%, 2nd 20%, 3rd 30%, etc.
Masking Spirit: Appear to have an alternate spirit per the spell Illusion of Feeling when felt through life sense, etc. unless an Illusion Resistance is requested and made.
Masking Soul: Appear to have an alternate soul per the spell Illusion of Feeling when felt through life sense, etc. unless an Illusion Resistance is requested and made.
Silence: The imbiber`s body no longer makes sound, except for speech when desired. Even involuntary noises are blocked.
Teleportation: The imbiber concentrates on a person, place, or thing and then teleports to the nearest open location within sight of it, unless that person, place, or thing is protected by magic, such as Wall of Protection, etc.
True Sight: The imbiber gains True Sight as the spell and is able to see through illusions, glamours, invisibility, masked Aura, spirits, etc. for the duration.
